base_rates.reading: shares of PRs with at least one flagged hunk; not rates of numeric oracle edits and not an agent-versus-human comparison (no adjustment for repository, PR size or hunk count; no test)

adapted_overcount.population: agent PRs of the public test-patch table
adapted_overcount.negative_sampling_stratum_note: adapted false AND a test file modified: size not recorded; bounded above by adapted_false_agent_prs
adapted_overcount.definition: adapted_true_agent_prs / (ppv * adapted_true_agent_prs + negative_rate * negative_stratum); upper: ppv at its Wilson lower bound and negative rate 0; lower: ppv at its Wilson upper bound, negative rate at its Wilson upper bound and the negative stratum at its upper bound
adapted_overcount.reading: both bounds exceed 1, so the column overcounts edits of existing expected values or tolerances among agent PRs within these single-rater samples; the bounds combine two separate 95 percent intervals at their extremes and are not a joint confidence interval
